additional_info.subject: FW: ID0375372-DC/Si-D/EE[MP / R2 170001453] Converter error CRM:01811000237
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Yesterday 01.09.2024 charger was out of order code 7
Power converters grout 3 and 4 also were showing errors E52.
After hard reset from OCPP, charger works  for now ok.
I was on site 27.08.2024  with support of L3 Sambath.
We checked relays Q32-Q34, all worked fine .
But after site visit 27.08.2024 when  seemed, that issue solved, it returned back. For example on Friday 30.08
I suppose it’s a FW bug.
